summary: Anchor checks treated failed UTF-8 decoding as the beginning or end of the haystack, allowing spurious ^/$ matches beside invalid bytes. The fix checks actual byte positions while retaining newline handling. This reversal restores the original ByteInput anchor checks. The fix-added bytes::invalidutf8_anchor1 test expects only (0, 0) and checks both find_iter and captures_iter; it is included in the default-bytes, nfa-bytes, and backtrack-bytes targets. Both source regions occur exactly once. No tests were executed.
